verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform, not a cap-table management system. Guided cap-table import, validation, and reconciliation are capabilities of the cap-table platform category, so this axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude ships a cap-table migration feature. Generic abilities like creating files, running code, or connecting to tools are building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate an existing cap table — from a spreadsheet or another platform — with guided import, validation, and reconciliation against source documents
